<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(frame):
    s={}
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('R','b','N') and n['pixels']==16 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50:
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            s[n['color']]=(min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']==12 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50:
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            s['piece']=(min(rows)-1,max(rows)+1,min(cols)-1,max(cols)+1)
    return s
print('start', snap(current_frame))
action(['UP','UP'])
print('after 2xUP', snap(current_frame))
r20 = current_frame.ascii.splitlines()[20]
print('row20:', r20[10:50])
action(['RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT'])
print('after 3xRIGHT', snap(current_frame))
print({k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('score','level_completed','done','board_changed')})
r20 = current_frame.ascii.splitlines()[20]
print('row20:', r20[10:50])

</function>
